dashboard.title: Ideshibhodi
dashboard.subtitle: Namathisela i-URL ye-gallery noma ye-profayela. U-Grabbr uzokwenza okusele.

modeHint.page: Ithola sonke isithombe esikhona ekhasini uqobo, ngisho nangaphandle komkhiphi ozinikele (gallery-dl generic:).
modeHint.scan: Ivula ikhasi, ithole izixhumanisi kumasayithi asekelwayo, futhi ilayishe kusuka kwesinye ngasinye (gallery-dl r:).

dashboard.modeMismatch: Leli sayithi linomkhiphi ozinikele. Sebenzisa Ngokuzenzakalelayo ukuze uthole izithumela. Ikhasi eliphelele / Skena kuthatha kuphela igobolondo lekhasi (amalogo, izithonjana) ngoba izithumela zilayishwa nge-JavaScript.
dashboard.invalidUrl: Sicela unamathisele isixhumanisi esisebenzayo (esiqala nge-http:// noma i-https://).
dashboard.noActive: Akukho okulayishwayo. Namathisela i-URL ngenhla ukuze uqale.
dashboard.needsAuth: Kubonakala sengathi kudinga ukungena. Setha amakhukhi
dashboard.cookiesLocked: U-Grabbr akakwazi ukufunda amakhukhi ebrawuza lakho ngenkathi livuliwe. Livale ngokuphelele, shintshela ku-Firefox, noma sebenzisa ifayela le-cookies.txt.
dashboard.rateLimited: Isayithi lincike izicelo ezivela ku-IP yakho. Ukulinda kuyasiza; ukuzama futhi ngokushesha kungenza ukuvinjwa kube inde. I-VPN noma i-proxy izokunika i-IP entsha.
dashboard.rateLimitedWait: Kuvinjelwe yisayithi. Kungcono ulinde eminye imizuzu engaba {{min}}. Usangakwazi ukuzama manje, kodwa lokhu kungenza ukuvinjwa kube inde.

preview.title: Buka kuqala
preview.subtitle: Lokhu ukuhamba kokuzama. Akukho okulayishiwe okwamanje.
preview.noFiles: Awekho amafayela atholiwe. I-URL kungenzeka ingasekelwe, iyimfihlo, noma idinga amakhukhi.
preview.needsAuth: Leli sayithi lidinga ukungena. Setha amakhukhi

history.title: Umlando
history.subtitle: Konke ukulayisha, ngophawu lwesikhathi.
history.clearConfirmDesc: Imisebenzi esebenzayo neselinde igcinwa. Amafayela wamalogi ayosuswa.
history.deleteConfirmDesc: Lokhu kususa ngokuphelele ifolda yokulayisha yalo msebenzi kusuka kudiski, bese kususa okufakiwe komlando. Lokhu akukwazi ukuhlehliswa.
history.sharedFolderNote: La mafayela ahlanganyela ifolda enkulu yokulayisha nokunye ukulayisha (Isakhiwo sefolda sisethelwe ku-"Ifolda eyodwa efletiwe"), ngakho angeke asuswe ngamunye. Sebenzisa Susa ukuze usule lokhu okufakiwe, noma ususe amafayela efoldeni ngokwakho.

settings.title: Izilungiselelo
settings.subtitle: Injini, ukubukeka, amathuluzi, namafayela. Izinguquko zigcinwa ngokuzenzakalelayo.
settings.folderCustomDesc: Amasimu e-gallery-dl ahlukaniswe ngeslash, isb. {category}/{user[name]}. Sebenzisa inkinobho ethi Faka isimu.
settings.defaultLimitDesc: Angaki amafayela okumele athathwe ngokulayisha ngakunye. Inombolo isho ama-N amasha kunawo wonke; noma ibanga elifana no-8-20 noma i-1:100:2. Okungenalutho = konke.
settings.maxConcurrentDesc: Angaki ama-URL alayishwa ngasikhathi sinye. Setha 0 ukuze umise umugqa.
settings.rateLimitDesc: Ubungako obukhulu bendlela yedatha, isb. 1M noma 500k. Okungenalutho = ngaphandle komkhawulo.
settings.proxyDesc: Iqondisa zonke izicelo nge-proxy, isb. http://host:port noma i-socks5://host:port. Kuwusizo uma isayithi liwuvinjezela i-IP yakho. Okungenalutho = ngqo.
settings.sleepRequestDesc: Ukulibaziseka ngaphambi kwesicelo ngasinye. Kusiza ukugwema ukuvinjwa okubangelwa umkhawulo wezinga.
settings.skipExistingDesc: Ikhumbula esikulayishile kakade, ukuze ukuphinda kusebenze i-URL kuthole kuphela amafayela amasha, ngisho nalawo owakususile kamuva. Cisha ukuze uphinde uhlole futhi uthole konke.
settings.writeMetadataDesc: Igcina ifayela le-.json elinolwazi lwesithumela eceleni kwefayela ngalinye.
settings.cookiesFolderEmpty: Awekho amafayela e-cookies.txt okwamanje. Thumela elilodwa livela kubrawuza lakho:
settings.cookiesFolderInfo: Wonke amafayela e-cookies.txt lapha ahlanganiswa futhi asetshenziswa kusayithi elifanele ngesizinda.
settings.browserRunning: U-{{name}} uyasebenza. Amabrawuza asuselwa ku-Chromium avala isizindalwazi samakhukhi ngenkathi evuliwe; vala u-{{name}} ukuze u-Grabbr akwazi ukuwufunda.
settings.startWithWindowsDesc: Iqalisa u-Grabbr uma ungena, incishiswe kuthreyi.
settings.notificationsDesc: Bonisa isaziso sedeskithophu uma ukulayisha kuqeda noma kwehluleka.
settings.dataFolderDesc: Isizindalwazi, ukumisa, amalogi, i-akhayivi yokulayisha, isikhwama se-gallery-dl, namathuluzi alayishiwe. Setha okuguquguqukayo kwemvelo i-GRABBR_DATA ukuze uyisuse.
settings.clearCacheDesc: Isusa izithombe ezincane ezenziwe kanye nesikhwama sangaphakathi se-gallery-dl. Akukho lokhu okulayishile okuthintwa.
settings.autoStartElectronOnly: Ukuqala ngokuzenzakalelayo kusebenza kuphela ohlelweni olupakishiwe
settings.componentsDesc: Amathuluzi ahlanganisiwe nalayishiwe kanye nezinguqulo zawo.
settings.privacyDesc: Lokho u-Grabbr akwenzayo nangakwenzi ngedatha yakho.
settings.privacyBody1: U-Grabbr usebenza ngokuphelele kumshini wakho. Akanawo ama-akhawunti, ukuhlaziya, i-telemetry, noma iseva yakhe. Ama-URL akho, ukulayisha, amakhukhi, nezilungiselelo akaze kaphume kukhompuyutha yakho nge-Grabbr.
settings.privacyBody2: Lapho uqala ukulayisha, u-Grabbr usebenzisa i-gallery-dl, exhumana ngqo namasayithi owanikeze, kanye nawo wonke amakhukhi ebrawuza noma ukungena okumise ekhasini lamaSayithi. Lezi zicelo ziya kulawo masayithi, kanjalo nje njengoba ubuwavakashile wena ngokwakho. Uma umisile i-proxy, ithrafikhi idlula kuyo.
settings.privacyBody3: Ikhasi lamathuluzi lilayisha i-gallery-dl, i-yt-dlp, ne-FFmpeg emithonjeni yazo esemthethweni uma ucela lokho. Ukuhlolwa kwenguqulo kulanda ifayela elincane lombhalo livela ku-GitHub nase-gyan.dev. Konke u-Grabbr akugcinayo kutholakala kufolda yedatha yendawo eboniswe ngenhla futhi kungasuswa noma nini.
settings.licenseTagline: Ungasebenzisa, kopisha, guqula, futhi usabalalise kabusha ngokukhululekile.
settings.noticesDesc: Izingxenye zangaphandle ezihlanganiswe no-Grabbr noma alayishayo.
settings.noticesFootnote: I-gallery-dl inelayisensi ngaphansi kwe-GPL-2.0 futhi ihlanganiswe njengefayela elingaguqukile elehlukile elisebenzayo elishaywa u-Grabbr njengenqubo encane. Ikhodi yomthombo ka-Grabbr ngokwayo iyi-MIT.

sites.title: Amasayithi
sites.supportedNote: Imodi Ezenzakalelayo isebenza ngamasayithi angaba ngu-350, iningi lawo lingadingi ukungena. Leli khasi lisho kuphela lawo adinga khona.
sites.uploadHint: Layisha i-cookies.txt yaleli sayithi, noma uyishiye kubrawuza elikhethiwe ngenhla kuMakhukhi Nokuqinisekisa.
sites.cookieFallback: Ayikho i-cookies.txt yaleli sayithi. U-Grabbr uzosebenzisa ibrawuza elikhethiwe.
sites.howItWorks: I-Instagram idinga amakhukhi kukho konke. I-Twitter iwadinga ku-NSFW / okuvikelekile / okunomkhawulo wezinga. I-Pixiv idinga i-refresh-token. Okuseleyo kungakhethwa kodwa kukhulisa imikhawulo.

welcome.title: Siyakwamukela ku-Grabbr
welcome.body: U-Grabbr uyi-frontend yedeskithophu ye-gallery-dl. Namathisela i-URL ye-gallery, iprofayela, noma isithumela bese ithola isethi ephelele yezithombe namavidiyo. Lolu hambo olusheshayo lumboza izikrini ezine.

dashboard.title: Ideshibhodi
dashboard.body: Namathisela i-URL eyodwa noma eziningi, eyodwa emugqeni ngamunye. Khetha imodi (Ngokuzenzakalelayo kufanele amasayithi angaba ngu-350), bese uchofoza Layisha. Ifolda yokulayisha kanye nokuqamba amafayela kutholakala ngaphansi komugqa uqobo.

sites.title: Amasayithi: ama-akhawunti ayimfihlo
sites.body: I-Instagram, i-Twitter, i-Pixiv nalezi ezifanayo zidinga ukungena. Khetha ibrawuza u-Grabbr azofunda amakhukhi kulo, noma ulayishe i-cookies.txt yaleso sayithi. I-Reddit, i-DeviantArt nezinye zisebenzisa i-OAuth yokuchofoza kanye.

tools.title: Amathuluzi Nezilungiselelo
tools.body: Kumavidiyo, faka i-FFmpeg ne-yt-dlp kusuka Ezilungiselelweni, Amathuluzi (ukuchofoza okukodwa ngasinye). Izilungiselelo naso siqukethe umkhawulo wokulayisha ozenzakalelayo, i-proxy, inani lokulayisha okufanayo ngesikhathi, itimu, ulimi, kanye nendawo yefolda yedatha.

history.title: Umlando
history.body: Konke ukulayisha kubalwe lapha. Nweba umugqa ukuze ubone izithombe ezincane, ilogi, ukulayisha futhi, ukuvula ifolda, noma ukususa amafayela kudiski. Ukususa okufakiwe akuze kuthinte amafayela akho ngaphandle kokuthi ukhethe ukususa Amafayela.
